baseline_native.description: official codex exec review of HEAD with no custom review prompt

goal_native.description: quality-review run-codex with one frozen change goal and candidate-only verification

cases.goal: Use the intended pricing source during checkout while preserving correct charge amounts and source-of-truth behavior.
cases.expected_root: Checkout selects the reporting-only analytics price instead of the authoritative price and sends the divergent value to the charger.

cases.goal: Reduce authorization lookup latency with a cache while preserving authoritative membership decisions.
cases.expected_root: No actionable defect: only a version-matched cached decision is used, and misses or mismatches synchronously fall back to the authority.

cases.goal: Refactor transfer persistence while preserving atomic account and ledger outcomes under failure.
cases.expected_root: The debit commits before a stable ledger-write failure and no rollback, compensation, or reconciliation restores the balance.

cases.goal: Move order-event delivery to an outbox while preserving atomic persistence and at-least-once delivery.
cases.expected_root: No actionable defect: order and outbox commit together, persisted events are reconciled, and event-keyed delivery is idempotent.

cases.goal: Validate requests and manage database connections while preserving pool availability on every return path.
cases.expected_root: The changed invalid-input return occurs after connection acquisition but before release, leaking one connection per normal invalid request.

cases.goal: Route fetches through the framework while preserving response-body lifecycle ownership.
cases.expected_root: No actionable defect: the framework path retains a deferred close and its test proves the response body is closed.

cases.goal: Simplify public resource updates while preserving authenticated tenant isolation.
cases.expected_root: The target removes the authenticated-tenant predicate from a public update, allowing a repeated tenant-local ID to select another tenant's resource.

cases.goal: Use gateway-verified identity for resource access while preserving editor authorization and tenant ownership.
cases.expected_root: No actionable defect: signed gateway identity, the editor-role check, and tenant-scoped lookup are all enforced.
